maritime.title: NERAI Maritime Weekly
events: FOLLOW-UP - Iran Declares Hormuz 'Never Returns to Pre-War Status'; Three Tankers Hit Mines
IRGC Claims Drone Attack on US Base in Bahrain; Sirens Sound in Manama
UK Sanctions Slavneft and Vessels Under Russia Regulations 2019
Ocean Network Express Returns to Suez as Container Lines Resume Red Sea Transits
EU Naval Patrol Active in Gulf of Aden as Somali Piracy Rebounds
maritime.summary: The Strait of Hormuz dominated this week's maritime picture, with multiple tankers struck by mines, Iran publicly declaring the waterway will never return to pre-war status, and IRGC drones targeting a US base in Bahrain — all while US-Iran diplomacy generated just enough noise to suppress an oil-price spike. A UK Russia-sanctions package targeting Slavneft and associated vessels added a compliance dimension, and the gradual return of container lines to the Suez Canal signalled cautious optimism on Red Sea de-escalation that the NERAI data does not yet fully corroborate.

sanctions.title: NERAI Sanctions Weekly
events: UK Sanctions Slavneft and Multiple Vessels Under Russia Regulations
EU Prepares 16th Russia Sanctions Round: 145 Targets Including 50 Banks
Rubio Declares Economic Pressure Renders Iran Military Strikes Unnecessary
Canada Announces Reimposition of Iran Sanctions After Decade-Long Gap
OFAC Sanctions Two Guatemalan DTOs Supporting Sinaloa Cartel and CJNG
sanctions.summary: The week of 10–16 November 2026 was dominated by three intersecting threads: an escalating US economic-pressure campaign against Iran that Secretary Rubio explicitly positioned as a substitute for military strikes, the EU's preparation of a new Russia sanctions round targeting roughly 145 entities including 50 banks, and a fresh UK designation package hitting Russian energy major Slavneft alongside several vessels. Canada's announcement of reimposed Iran sanctions added a secondary multilateral dimension, while EU customs-enforcement watchdog findings underscored the persistent gap between sanctions legislation and on-the-ground compliance.
